origin.description: Remove selected ANSI sequences. The result is plain text.
origin.usage: ansi_strip(string, sgr = TRUE, csi = TRUE, link = TRUE)

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: A string or a list of strings.

origin.details: Removes SGR, other CSI, and OSC 8 hyperlinks.
origin.value: The string with the selected sequences removed.
